changes.text: M2VTP BottleCap: human bottle-cap turning with a Zhejiang University glove of 20 binary touch signals and egocentric HoloLens 2 video (ICRA 2024); one OneDrive file linked from the pretraining README, files not opened, sequence count not published.

DexSkills: Allegro hand with 4 magnetic fingertip sensors teleoperated through an HGlove, 20 primitive skills and 20 long-horizon tasks released on GitHub as preprocessed haptic feature tensors (318 MB with checkpoints), no video, no license file.

M2VTP: masked visual-tactile transformer pretrained on egocentric video and 20 binary glove signals, then embedded in RL for a ShadowHand turning a bottle cap; code (MIT) on GitHub and pretrained models on OneDrive.
DexSkills: temporal autoencoder that labels 20 primitive skills from fingertip touch and proprioception on an Allegro hand, with one behaviour-cloned MLP per skill; code and 18 checkpoints on GitHub.

AdapTac-Dex: diffusion policy for a LEAP hand with 8 PaXini pads that predicts future net force to weight vision against touch (IROS 2025, 93% average success on 3 tasks); code on GitHub, only the tactile encoder checkpoint on Hugging Face.
RLHND: Cosmos 3 video backbone that estimates MANO hand pose and per-vertex contact and force from egocentric RGB, its tactile stream trained on 1,469 OpenTouch clips; code and weights announced.

SCS: LSTM that maps 8 fingertip touch channels from a glove worn in human grasps to grasp-stability states, driving a fuzzy grip-force controller on a robot hand with matching sensors (National Science Review 2025); data on request, no code statement.

Tactile-GAT: graph attention network that classifies 19 grasped objects from a 22-channel glove (16 FSR402 pressure, 6 flex) at 89.58% accuracy (Scientific Reports 2024); code on GitHub, data on request.
OSMO: published in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (2026-05-11); venue updated from arXiv 2512.08920 and the DOI added to sources.
